defaults.negative_prompt: text, letters, subtitles, watermark, logo, deformed, extra fingers, blurry, low quality, morphing, distorted face, flicker

args.prompt: The red-haired woman urgently shakes the sleepy man's shoulder, he blinks, yawns and sits up, the phone on the nightstand lights up. Hand-drawn comic book animation, consistent cartoon style, smooth motion, no text.

The man proudly slides his passport across the counter and smiles confidently, people in the queue behind him shift and look around, subtle camera push-in. Hand-drawn comic book animation, consistent cartoon style, smooth motion, no text.

The red-haired woman holds the phone to her ear, listens anxiously and shakes her head, the man paces nervously and runs his hand through his hair, slight handheld camera. Hand-drawn comic book animation, consistent cartoon style, smooth motion, no text.

The elderly grandmother talks very fast and excitedly into the phone, waving her free hand, nodding and laughing, her curlers bouncing. Hand-drawn comic book animation, consistent cartoon style, smooth motion, no text.

The red-haired woman speaks calmly and confidently into the phone with a small smile, the man next to her stares at her in amazement, then slowly smiles. Hand-drawn comic book animation, consistent cartoon style, smooth motion, no text.

The trio stand at the counter smiling with relief, the grandmother proudly raises her documents, behind the glass the clerk raises one eyebrow sceptically. Hand-drawn comic book animation, consistent cartoon style, smooth motion, no text.
